ubscriber along with copy of Board resolution and attendance sheet. In case of a subscriber which is a limited lia
bility partnership, copy of valid NIC/ Passport of designated partner empowered to act as such, along with copy

rticles, copy of the certificate of incorporation, Board resolution by the foreign company for appointment of nomin

rt and an undertaking on stamp paper of requisite value duly signed, notarized and witnessed;
